title: Multivariable and vector calculus
purpose: Differentiate and integrate in several variables and apply the integral theorems to physical fields.

blocks.deliverable: Parametrize a curve and calculate velocity and tangent vectors.
Solve a Lagrange multiplier problem and interpret the constraint.
Choose coordinates and justify integration bounds.
Week 7 midterm; compute and interpret a Jacobian.
Test path independence on a specified domain.
Verify one theorem on a concrete smooth example.
Submit both flux calculations and a 120 minute final.

project: Calculate flux through a closed surface both directly and with the divergence theorem.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
